entry.value: Metanode for computation of selected descriptive statistics for selected columns.%%00010%%00010Selected descriptive statistics are:%%00010count - count of numerical values%%00010mad - median absolute deviation%%00010max - maximum%%00010min - minimum%%00010median - median%%00010mean - mean%%00010sem - standard error of the mean%%00010sum - sum%%00010std - standard deviation%%00010var - variance%%00010%%00010Statistics are calculated using pandas DataFrame statistics, more details can be found e.g. here https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/reference/frame.html#computations-descriptive-stats%%00010%%00010Sum function returns missing value in case of only missing values sum (default pandas behavior was adjusted in this matter).%%00010%%00010You can select what descriptive statistics should be calculated, prefix and suffix (added prior and after the sample name got from the design matrix) for newly added columns.
